errors.evidence: The bars are not presented in alphabetical order. The order is: RoBERTa w/o Exp., ExEnt, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum).

errors.text_span: The bars are grouped by color
errors.evidence: The bars are not grouped; each bar represents a distinct category and is individually colored.
The full name for the category represented by the dark gray bar is "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)", not just "+ curriculum".

errors.text_span: followed by LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) at approximately 61%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the same bar (the tallest dark gray one) twice as if it were a separate data point. There is only one bar for "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)".
The accuracy for "LaSQuE (mean)" (the orange bar) is approximately 46.5%, not 55%. The value 55% corresponds to the "ExEnt" bar.
The accuracy for "ExEnt" is approximately 55%, not 56%. The description assigns an incorrect value.
The accuracy for "RoBERTa w/o Exp" is approximately 46%, not 52%. This is a significant overestimation.
The description completely omits the "LaSQuE" model (green bar), which has an accuracy of approximately 46.5%.

errors.text_span: All bars are listed in order of appearance from left to right
errors.evidence: This statement contradicts the preceding list of bars, which was incorrectly ordered by descending height rather than by appearance from left to right, making the description confusing and self-contradictory.
